_comment: What verify.ts actually says about each committed track, known failures included. Read by src/track/tracks.test.ts and scripts/snapshot.mjs: a verdict that changes in either direction fails both. Nothing here loosens a check - the failures still show red in the viewer. Each FAIL and SKIP is explained in docs/phase0-geometry-report.md.

why.A: 5641.9 m against the published 5793 m, -2.61%: a spline through 11 corner markers is shorter than the track.
why.F: 0.940 turns. The loop does turn exactly once (sum of vertex headings); buildFrame's per-sample curvature cannot represent the single 120.4 deg vertex at the T11 marker.

why.C: Corners in s order run T12..T15, T1..T11: sf_idx 729 sits between T11 and T12, not before T1.
